choices.assertion: Chromium opened its real filechooser event and accepted synthetic multi-file fixtures. Across both forms, five locales and 320/390px, long names retained all characters and wrapped inside their row without overlap or horizontal overflow. Localized replacement help, size, individual removal, focus, count, preserved drafts and absence of file-operation transport were observed.
